Original Table I training group 2. The 46,683 denominator and 0.7% serious rate match. The later archive gives 327 serious outcomes and identifies Motley, reference 49.
Original Table I training group 3. The 4,337 denominator and 0.6% serious rate match. The later archive gives 26 serious outcomes and identifies Motley, reference 49.
Original Table I training group 4. The 9,738 denominator and 0.2% serious rate match. The later archive gives 19 serious outcomes and identifies Motley, reference 49.

Smedal Table I has 245 exposures, 10.6% with any pain, exercise at 26,000 ft, about 5.2 psia, and 20 min. NASA Appendix C cites Smedal, reference 60, with zero serious outcomes. Smedal prints 0.4% requiring descent and the classification differs from serious DCS.
Smedal Table I has 379 resting exposures at 26,000 ft and 20 min, with 1.3% any pain. NASA Appendix C cites that report, reference 60. Both compilations give zero serious outcomes.

NASA Appendix C cites Vakar, reference 64. The translation reports exactly 434 exposures at 7,000 m and two mild disorders with six hours of exercise. The printed 0.41%, HDSD 0.4% and the rate calculated from 2/434 remain distinct.
The groups have 585 exposures and zero serious outcomes. NASA Appendix C cites Sedov, reference 59. The original counts by gas condition and independent protocol identifiers are unavailable.

The HDSD and Appendix C list 343 exposures and zero serious outcomes. Appendix C cites Beard, reference 11. The original gives a matching 5.0 psia, 2.5-hour cabin stage and 334 simulated flights overall. It does not specify a 343-exposure risk set for that stage.

Gray and Masland Table I identifies 223 resting exposures at 38,000 ft for two hours, matching the HDSD profile. Its chokes-only and combined bends-and-chokes percentages are 4.5% and 0.45%. The HDSD prints 5.0% serious DCS, and Appendix C gives 11/223 (4.93%) from Gray Report 458. Preserve all percentages and the distinct all-cause descent endpoint.

Both compilations give 204 exposures, and 4/204 rounds to the HDSD's 2.0%. Appendix C cites Gray Report 458, reference 32. A separate 204-exposure row also exists, and original group identifiers are missing.

The HDSD reports 6.0% serious DCS at 3.0 psia with exercise in 204 exposures. Appendix C cites CAM 137, a 38,000-ft exercise report, and gives 12/204 (5.88%). The standalone report was unavailable and the percentages differ.
